summary: This video breaks down the upcoming summon banner roadmap and provides dice spending strategies for both new and veteran players. The creator recommends skipping Mithrasea and Elecebre banners to save Heliolite Dice for high-value events like Child of Chaos, Option Summons, and Wish Summons. Child of Chaos is highlighted as a high-priority limited exclusive support hero who won't return after his banner ends. Option Summons 1 and 2 offer custom school selection for hard-to-get supports and DPS heroes, while the Wish Banner guarantees top-tier exclusive damage dealers at 300 and 800 summons.

tips: Save at least 300 Heliolite Dice to reach the guaranteed hero milestone on exclusive support banners like Child of Chaos.
Prioritize Option Summons 1 and 2 to pick specific hero schools and pull essential duplicate heroes needed to buy Mythic Artifacts.
Skip the Elecebre banner to gather extra dice for the Wish Banner, which guarantees exclusive DPS heroes at 300 and 800 summons.
Focus on building solid support heroes and obtaining hero dupes early to unlock game-changing artifacts for PvP and boss content.
